scope: Research and CPU still-image comparisons only. No new GPU inference, model weights, app changes or draft changes.
pairedRunLimits: One resolution pair on one A6000. Resolution changes noise dimensions and subsequent repaint inputs. Total times include the complete observed run lifecycle; native segment times and facial worker times are separate, not alternate full-generation timings.

visualReview.finding: 704p raw frames have clearer facial features/detail than 480p on this pair. Both finished outputs soften fine detail and alter some makeup, lip and midface appearance relative to their raw animations. This is not a validated geometry or identity lock. No 720p inference was performed.

faceFusionCPU.variants: Direct swap on the raw saved frames, face_swapper_weight 0.5 and 1.0. These embedding weights are not the production 60% RGB output blend.
faceFusionCPU.finding: Stronger direct swapping changes likeness/details but does not consistently restore the fixed reference proportions in these still samples. Full temporal behavior and source-performance fidelity were not validated for these variants.
faceFusionCPU.geometryCaveat: Detected landmark ratios vary with pose, expression and detector error; they are diagnostics, not identity scores or measurements of physical bone drift.
faceFusionCPU.protection: Original jobs/media were read only. Probe outputs live outside Studio and no production recipe was selected.

pipelineFinding: The expression stage derives canonical structure and appearance from each generated target. Hyperswap aligns to that target geometry and uses a fixed donor identity embedding; the current residual compositor blends appearance without hard-locking donor skull/eye/mouth geometry. Some apparent width changes can also come from expression, pose and shading.

publisherAdapter.publisherClaim: MiniMax H3 REF2VA face-swap LoRA, Faceswap trigger, strength 1, reference-image identity.
publisherAdapter.recipe: Native pruned INT8 MiniMax H3 REF2VA, Qwen3-VL 32B NVFP4/AWQ encoder, audio VAE, shared existing video VAE, separate 8-step turbo adapter and face-swap LoRA. KSampler 8 steps/CFG 1/res_multistep/simple. Native reference-to-video widget dimensions are linked from video preprocessing, not proof of a 1344x768 render.
publisherAdapter.conditioning: The native encoder processes the source video and references. The current Viggle fixed conditioning is not a demonstrated substitute. Tensor compatibility does not establish quality compatibility with the Viggle fine-tune and distillation recipe.

includedDemo.review: Reference appearance transfer is visible, but supplied source/output samples differ in hands, framing and camera distance. The included demo does not establish frame-accurate motion preservation.

publisherAdapter.conclusion: Promising separate generative face-editing candidate, not a measured speedup or proven drop-in adapter. No matched inference or VRAM benchmark was run on this setup.
publisherAdapter.license: LoRA card says Apache-2.0; this does not remove underlying base/dependency license requirements or establish hosted-service clearance.

resolution720.timeEstimate: 10-25% longer video rendering if memory/offload behavior stays similar; not measured and not a guaranteed upper bound. Fixed-cost facial passes/transfers mean complete-job scaling can differ.
resolution720.recommendation: 704p remains the reasonable working choice for small output-detail gains; 720p does not add an identity-geometry constraint.

nextEvaluation: Prefer comparisons on the existing paid animation before buying another H3 stack. Isolate expression-induced geometry changes from swapping/blending. Any fixed-identity/relative-expression correction remains experimental; earlier canonical-geometry experiments were not accepted. Do not force a user setting, stronger swap or new default from seven stills.
